summary: Reviewed the Settings → Skills split workbench (SkillsSettings.svelte, SkillEditor.svelte, SkillList.svelte, settings.css, SettingsScreen.svelte, SettingsNav.svelte) against desktop.png and mobile.png screenshots using the impeccable critique skill and svelte-autofixer. Disposition is 'fix' because, while the persistent library/editor split satisfies the full-area requirement, unsaved-work safety, mobile responsiveness, empty-state messaging, and accessibility all need work.
decisions: Disposition: 'fix' — the persistent library-left + editor-right split is correct, but blocking issues remain.
Unsaved-work safety must be broadened beyond just selecting another skill to also cover settings-page navigation, workspace navigation, page unload, and uninstalling the active skill.
Mobile layout needs a master-detail library/editor pattern with 100dvh sizing instead of stacking the full settings nav, a 340px library, and a fixed 560px editor.
Empty state must distinguish initial loading, genuinely empty libraries, filtered-empty results, and connection errors rather than showing '0 of 0 on' / 'No skills match' prematurely.
Search input needs a visible :focus-within treatment since the native outline is suppressed.
Editor/loading/save-error/unsaved states require proper aria-current, aria-live, or alert semantics; selection via data-selected alone is insufficient.
errors: svelte-autofixer reported no issues on SkillsSettings.svelte, SkillEditor.svelte, or SkillList.svelte (likely incomplete coverage of the reviewer's concerns).
Screenshots desktop.png and mobile.png showed no loaded skill data due to headless-client timing, so populated/editor states could only be evaluated by reading source rather than visually.
